extracted.intended_audience: corporate legal counsel, investor relations officers, and registrants preparing SEC Form 8-K filings
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and furnishing a Form 8-K Item 7.01 Regulation FD disclosure that furnishes an investor presentation as an exhibit and satisfies related SEC filing disclosures and certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation FD Disclosure — furnish investor presentation (Item 7.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Senior management intends to present the Investor Presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, to analysts and investors from time to time on or after August 12, 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Investor Presentation will be available on the Investor Relation page at the Company’s website (simpsonmfg.com). The presentation should be furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information furnished under Item 7.01 not 'filed' for Section 18 purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: The information furnished pursuant to this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1 furnished herewith, shall not be deemed 'filed' for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the term 'furnished' rather than 'filed' when appropriate; include the explicit disclaimer that the furnished information is not deemed filed under Section 18 and not incorporated by reference unless specifically referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward-looking statements / Safe Harbor disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The information furnished pursuant to this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1 furnished herewith, contains 'forward-looking statements' within the meaning of the safe harbor provisions of the federal securities laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State that the material contains forward-looking statements and advise readers to read it in conjunction with the 'Safe Harbor' statement contained in the Investor Presentation, the risk factors in the company’s periodic reports filed with the SEC, and other public announcements (press releases, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibits listing (Item 9.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: List and describe exhibits furnished or filed with the Form 8-K (e.g., Exhibit 99.1 — Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc. Investors Presentation; Exhibit 104 — Cover Page Interactive Data File).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include exhibit numbers and brief descriptions. If Inline XBRL or interactive data files are included, identify them (e.g., Cover Page Interactive Data File embedded within the Inline XBRL document).

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature by authorized officer
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant must cause the report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the signature block with date, printed name, and title of the signing officer (example: /s/ Brian J. Magstadt — Brian J. Magstadt, Chief Financial Officer; DATE: August 12, 2019).

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate simultaneous filing intent under specific SEC rules (checkboxes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Check the appropriate box if the Form 8-K filing is intended to simultaneously satisfy the filing obligation of the registrant under any of the following: Rule 425 under the Securities Act (17 CFR 230.425); Rule 14a-12 under the Exchange Act (17 CFR 240.14a-12); Rule 14d-2(b) under the Exchange Act (17 CFR 240.14d-2(b)); Rule 13e-4(c) under the Exchange Act (17 CFR 240.13e-4(c)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each applicable rule, mark the box to indicate whether the Form 8-K is intended to satisfy those specific simultaneous filing obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emerging growth company status and transition-period election
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate by check mark whether the registrant is an emerging growth company as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act or Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act, and if an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the emerging growth company checkbox and, if applicable, the checkbox regarding election not to use the extended transition period for accounting standard compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrant identification and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the exact name of the registrant as specified in its charter; state or other jurisdiction of incorporation; Commission file number; I.R.S. Employer Identification No.; address of principal executive offices; and registrant’s telephone number (including area code).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full corporate identification details at the top of the Form 8-K (example values shown: Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc.; Delaware; 1-13429; 94-3196943; 5956 W. Las Positas Boulevard, Pleasanton, CA 94588; (925) 560-9000).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the title of each class of securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act, the trading symbol, and the name of each exchange on which registered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share', Trading Symbol: 'SSD', Name of Exchange: 'New York Stock Exchange'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date of Report / Date of earliest event reported
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Date of Report (Date of earliest event reported) at the top of the Form 8-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example from this filing: 'Date of Report (Date of earliest event reported): August 12, 2019'. Ensure the date corresponds to the earliest reportable event.
